description.zh: 指定要查询的资产组名称，不支持模糊查询，只支持精确查询。
description.en: The name of the host group that you want to query. Only exact match is supported.

description.zh:
指定要查询的堡垒机的实例ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstances](~~462953~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the bastion host to query.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~462953~~) operation to query the bastion host ID.

description.zh: 指定分页查询时当前页的页码。默认值为**1**。

指定分页查询时每页显示的数据最大条数。pagesize参数最大取值为100。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，pagesize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
> 建议pagesize取值不要为空。
description.en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned on each page.

> We recommend that you do not leave this parameter empty.

description.zh:
指定要查询的堡垒机的区域ID。
> 区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。
description.en:
The region ID of the bastion host in which you want to query the host group.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

title.zh: 获取指定堡垒机下的资产组列表

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-host-groups --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --host-group-name HostGroup1 --region cn-hangzhou
